design_overview: A modern, production-ready inventory management system designed for mobile-first interaction with clear visual hierarchy, intuitive navigation, and real-time data updates. The design prioritizes quick access to critical functions like barcode scanning, inventory tracking, and alerts while maintaining a clean, professional aesthetic suitable for retail environments. The interface uses a card-based layout with strong CTAs, scannable lists, and contextual actions that guide users through common workflows efficiently.

responsive_design: Mobile-first design optimized for iOS and Android devices with 375px-428px width. All touch targets minimum 44x44px for accessibility. Layouts use flexible containers that adapt to screen size. Bottom navigation fixed for easy thumb access. Forms scroll vertically with sticky header and action buttons. Cards and lists use full width on mobile with 16px horizontal padding. Tablet layouts (768px+) show two-column grids for inventory and alerts. Desktop web version (1024px+) uses sidebar navigation instead of bottom bar and displays content in centered 1200px max-width container.
accessibility: All interactive elements meet WCAG 2.1 AA standards with minimum 44x44px touch targets. Color contrast ratios exceed 4.5:1 for text and 3:1 for UI components. Form inputs include visible labels and placeholder text. Error states provide clear text descriptions, not just color. Icons paired with text labels for clarity. Screen reader support with semantic HTML and ARIA labels. Keyboard navigation support for web version. Focus indicators visible on all interactive elements. Alert notifications include both visual and text indicators. Font sizes minimum 16px for body text, scalable up to 200% without breaking layout.
animations: Subtle micro-interactions enhance usability without distraction. Button press shows 95% scale with 150ms ease-out. Screen transitions use 300ms slide animations (right for forward, left for back). Bottom sheet modals slide up with 250ms ease-out and backdrop fade. List items fade in sequentially with 50ms stagger on load. Pull-to-refresh shows elastic bounce animation. Swipe actions reveal with spring physics. Loading states use skeleton screens with shimmer effect. Success actions show brief checkmark animation. Alert badges pulse gently to draw attention. Barcode scanner reticle has continuous subtle pulse. All animations respect reduced motion preferences.
icons: Consistent icon set using outlined style from Lucide or Heroicons library. Icons sized 20px for inline use, 24px for buttons, 32px for headers. Primary icons: home (dashboard), search (scan/search), user (profile), settings (configuration), bell (alerts/notifications), bookmark (saved items), heart (favorites), filter (sort/filter), plus (add/create), edit (modify), trash (delete), share (export/share). All icons have 2px stroke width for consistency. Icons always paired with labels except in bottom navigation where labels appear below. Icon color matches text color in context (primary for active states, secondary for inactive).
